description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join a consumer technology research team evaluating how AI models behave alongside real people. You will design and ship practical benchmarks that measure real-world model behavior, helping distinguish meaningful results from evaluations that can be gamed.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Develop and publish benchmarks regularly, taking each from an initial idea through its results.

 - Design studies with clear tasks, no-AI baselines, participant consent, and measurable real-world actions.

 - Build evaluation harnesses that isolate model performance from prompt wording, and run leading models through them.

 - Create grading systems using ground truth, verifiers, and rubrics.

 - Document methods and write up findings for publication.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 0 to 3 years of research or engineering experience, with an early PhD or research-minded undergraduate background.

 - Experience building and shipping an evaluation, benchmark, or human study end to end.

 - Strong Python skills and experience using model APIs at scale.

 - Understanding of model cards, how evaluations can be gamed, and how to design technically serious tests.

 - Experience designing studies and building grading systems with ground truth, verifiers, and rubrics.

 - Relevant background may include human-subject research in psychology, HCI, or social science; research on persuasion, sycophancy, or deception; speech or audio; or a published paper or open benchmark.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Salary range: $180,000 to $350,000 annually, plus equity. Visa sponsorship is available.


LOCATION

On-site in Palo Alto, California.
